implementation.target_verifier: dsparkBeginWith serial verifier plus dsparkFinish rollback/commit
implementation.tree_shape: all retained full-depth k=3 leaves; k=1 is independently verified from the same prefix
implementation.state_gate: candidate next token, decode-state fingerprint, and live-state content hash equal an independent serial replay
fail_closed: empty, malformed, and out-of-vocabulary branches are rejected
no serving path selects the test-only serial override

pure_cpu: .zig-toolchain/zig build test -Dtest-filter='PCTree branch acceptance scan' -Doptimize=ReleaseSafe --summary all
commands.deferred_dsv4_mini: DSV4_MINI=/tmp/dsv4-mini .zig-toolchain/zig build test -Dtest-filter='PCTree retained branches use the serial B1-B5 verifier' -Doptimize=ReleaseFast --summary all

predeclared_interpretation.k1_gate: PCTree k=1 must equal the runtime draft ids and produce the same accepted length and correction token through separate serial-verifier executions.
predeclared_interpretation.branch_gate: Every retained full-depth k=3 leaf must pass the target-state replay gate. The receipt records the best accepted length and its delta versus k=1 without treating a non-positive outcome as failure of the oracle.
predeclared_interpretation.prototype_gate: Do not implement a tree-shaped verifier unless this measurement is correct and shows a reproducible positive k>1 acceptance delta.

adverse_evidence.active_workload: An omlx-server process and an active DeepSeek corpus-generation Python process were observed before the attempted DSV4_MINI run; the latter was using substantial CPU and unified memory.
